items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: and I think Ernest Lewis would play at the Kitto at the time.

ctx.x: He was just playing trumpet. Well him and myself, Wilford Boccage, and let's see, I was on piano, he was on trumpet, Wilford Boccage, saxophone, and I think Ernest Lewis would play at the Kitto at the time.
